facts.claim: 女警转过身，隔着庭院向“我”挥手打招呼。
facts.quote: The policewoman had turned around. She gave me a little wave

facts.claim: 女警自称凯·亚当斯警探，并同丹·卡拉威握手。
facts.quote: She stuck out her hand. “I’m Detective Kay Adams.”

facts.claim: 丹·卡拉威光着上身、晃着出现在门口，一副要吐的样子。
facts.quote: Dan Caraway swayed in the entrance, looking as though he might vomit.

facts.claim: “我”弯腰细看，发现死者手里攥着一瓶鼻腔喷雾。
facts.quote: The object in her hand was a bottle of nasal spray

facts.claim: 萝丝说早餐本该七点就绪，是这事耽搁了她。
facts.quote: It should have been ready at seven, but this delayed me.

facts.claim: 亚当斯警探让众人先去餐厅聚齐，并留在那里等她问话。
facts.quote: How about you head on over there now, and encourage everyone else to join you?

facts.claim: “我”看清她胸牌上写的是“凯登丝·亚当斯”，并非凯。
facts.quote: a nametag on the chest of her shirt, which read DET. KAYDENCE ADAMS.

facts.claim: “我”被客气地请走，只好退回庭院、往东端的塔楼去。
facts.quote: I retreated in defeat—back across the garden courtyard, and toward the tower

relations.rel: 警探盘问目击者，被贝尔暗自揣度身份
relations.quote: “Now who do I have the pleasure of speaking with?”

relations.rel: 同住一屋，一同出来应对警察
relations.quote: Behind him stood Rose Tillohash, looking precisely as she had the night before

relations.rel: 警探守着尸体、不许贝尔靠近
relations.quote: the way she stepped firmly now between me and the body

relations.rel: 主动提出给警队供餐以示配合
relations.quote: “We’re happy to feed you, and anyone from your team.”

relations.rel: 趁警察背身窥看死者手中的物件
relations.quote: I took the opportunity to examine Deirdre Gregory’s body more closely

numbers.claim: 只看得见她脸的下半部分
numbers.quote: the lower half of her face

numbers.claim: 她先把对讲机插回腰间皮套
numbers.quote: The policewoman replaced her two-way radio in her waist holder

numbers.claim: 她咂舌三次，像花栗鼠的叫声
numbers.quote: unsticking her tongue from the roof of her mouth three times

numbers.claim: 她一只手按在自己胸口
numbers.quote: she pressed the palm of one hand to her chest
It should have been ready at seven, but this delayed me.

numbers.claim: 他躯干上有若干热带鸟色的纹身
numbers.quote: his torso bearing a number of tattoos in the same tropical-bird colors

numbers.claim: 死者手里是一瓶鼻腔喷雾
萝丝意识到要多招待许多客人
numbers.quote: the prospect of having to serve a far greater number of guests register for Rose

turning_point: 凯登丝·亚当斯警探以阳光无害的姿态把所有人赶去餐厅、把贝尔请离尸体，贝尔在死者手中瞥见一瓶鼻腔喷雾后即被逐走，只能退往东端塔楼。
notes: 女警胸牌写 DET. KAYDENCE ADAMS，她口头自称 Detective Kay Adams，贝尔据胸牌改口称 Kaydence；警察究竟是县警副警长还是警探，贝尔本人也存疑（uniform 与 detective 身份不符），属未解释处。
